newsitem.title: USA: Lam Q3 book-to-bill ratio rises to 1.19.
newsitem.headline: Lam Q3 book-to-bill ratio rises to 1.19.

text.p: Lam Research Corp on Tuesday said its fiscal third quarter book-to-bill ratio rose to 1.19-to-1, up from 1.14-to-1 in its fiscal second quarter.

A book-to-bill ratio of 1.19-to-1 means for every $100 worth of product shipments the company received $119 worth of product orders, and it is considered a general sign of health in the semiconductor equipment industry in which Lam operates.
Earlier, the company reported a third quarter, ended March 31, loss of $1.46 per share on a fully diluted basis versus a fully diluted profit of $1.28 per share one year ago.
Lam shares were off 3/4 to 32-7/8 by mid-morning.
